title: Quetschentaart
description: A traditional Luxembourg dish made with shortcrust pastry, plum. This home-style preparation follows its characteristic cooking method and uses measured ingredients.

steps.instruction: Roll or press the prepared dough evenly into the desired thickness and shape.
Layer the prepared elements evenly in the baking dish, spreading filling right to the edges.
Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for about 42 minutes until set, golden and cooked through. Cool on a rack.
